coreIntegration.reason: Root package.json only adds playground and test:playground scripts; lockfile and all recorded core sources unchanged.
coreIntegration.reused: Existing core Node 24, core Chromium and isolated tarball verification; source/artifact matches confirmed. Historical evidence is preserved, not overwritten.

limitations: Inspectors expose View-level State/Derived, Query and observed event Action IDs, not all internal Component execution cells.
Preview supports nine playground-owned components plus declarative compositions; no Grid/chart UI or general renderer SDK.
Native textarea editor: no syntax highlighting, completion or source hot reload; Shift+Tab exits indentation capture.
Draft limit 1MB UTF-8; displayed values capped at 40000 characters/depth 20; preview capped at 3000 nodes. Truncated snapshots are diagnostics, not complete JSON exports.
Chromium only; other browsers, real mobile input methods/touch and large document performance not verified.
External APIs use browser CORS; no proxy, secret resolver or hosted deployment.
publication: Local split commits requested and prepared; no push, remote CI execution or package publication.

imeFollowup.report: User observed broken Korean input in the Query/Action example concept search.
imeFollowup.cause: Snapshot rendering assigned the last committed State value to an input during active IME composition. Chromium cancelled composition without compositionend, leaving the input handler stuck in composing mode.

fixedFindings.before: Blank input remained visually blank after blur while State retained its value.
fixedFindings.after: Preserve intermediate numeric editing and same-value numeric notation; synchronize to the current State on blur. Negative fractions and exponent input verified.

fixedFindings.before: Action retry and Query gate recovery succeeded while their previous error banner persisted.
fixedFindings.after: Track errors by event connection or Query; clear on corresponding recovery, retain failures in Log, and do not clear due to unrelated success.

fixedFindings.before: Reordering retained input DOM with insertBefore dropped focus and interrupted IME.
fixedFindings.after: Reorder siblings around the retained focused subtree, preserving focus, native composition and Component-local State; removal/re-add starts fresh.

fixedFindings.before: A delayed file read overwrote a newer editor change.
fixedFindings.after: Draft revision and import ordering prevent stale file results or errors from replacing newer work.

fixedFindings.before: A 3000-node display-limit error banner coexisted with ready status.
fixedFindings.after: An active display error takes precedence in run status and clears after successful rendering.

fixedFindings.before: Request target //[ raised an uncaught Invalid URL exception and terminated the server with code 1.
fixedFindings.after: Return HTTP 400 and continue serving subsequent requests.
